plain: A long, formal written work on one subject

webster.text: A tract; a written composition on a particular subject, in which the principles of it are discussed or explained.

example.quote: I present you a small treatise in defence of those principles of freedom which your exemplary virtue hath so eminently contributed to establish.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
